A small '''sensor array''' was built outside the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Kwilaan (city)|Kwilaan]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. The entrance to the [[Sensor array/Legends|array]] consisted of a flight of stairs with three statues of [[Human/Legends|Humans]] on each side. It was used by by the Human [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] and was operated by two [[Technician/Legends|technicians]] while being lightly guarded by four [[Naboo Palace Guard/Legends|Palace Guards]].<ref name="SI" />

{{RPGseed}}
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">The [[attack on the Kwilaan sensor array]] in "[[Signal Interruption]]" took place shortly before the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> the sensor array was targeted by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] in preparation for their [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion of Naboo]]. They planned to sever Naboo's communications by placing [[Jammer/Legends|jamming]] [[Satellite/Legends|satellites]] around the planet and needed the array deactivated for several [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] to place them undetected. Trade Federation operative [[Raymas Daal]] hired a group of agents to deactivate the [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] array. The group [[Attack on the Kwilaan sensor array|knocked]] out the palace guards and dealt with the technicians in order to deactivate the array, allowing the Trade Federation to place their satellites.<ref name="SI" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The sensor array was mentioned in the ''[[Star Wars: Invasion of Theed Adventure Game]]'' scenario "[[Signal Interruption]]," written by [[Jesse Decker]] and published on the ''[[Wizards of the Coast]]'' website on [[August 9]], [[2001]]. Players control the agents hired by Daal, which the scenario suggests may be the playable characters from the ''Invasion of Theed Adventure Game'': [[Dané]], [[Galak]], [[Rann I-Kanu]], [[Arani Korden]], [[Rorworr (Naboo)|Rorworr]], [[Deel Surool]], [[Toba]], and [[Sia-Lan Wezz]]. To complete the scenario, the players must strategize how to deal with the Palace Guards at the array, either by sneaking in or openly attacking. They also choose how to deal with the technicians, with Decker writing that the technicians will not attack unless struck first, and even in that case they are likely to attempt an escape first.<ref name="SI" /> This article assumes that the events of "Signal Interruption" occurred as described in the text.
